persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.

persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make an 8-second widescreen cartoon of a little orange robot watering a potted plant. Put 'Small steps' at the top throughout. No sound.
bank.Which video to use: The video just made in the preceding turn, not a newly generated version.
bank.Reframing method: Fit the entire original widescreen picture in the centre without cropping or stretching, with plain navy padding above and below.
bank.Length and timing: Keep the original 8-second duration and all action timing exactly the same.
bank.Text: Keep 'Small steps' visible at the top of the original picture throughout.
bank.Subject and style: Retain the original cartoon of a little orange robot watering a potted plant.

messages.text: Could you make a cartoon of a little orange robot watering a potted plant? I have a soft spot for little robots doing ordinary things, which is why this idea appeals to me. For the video itself, I want it to be 8 seconds long and widescreen. Please put 'Small steps' at the top throughout, and have no sound. I'm probably over-explaining because I've been picturing this little scene for a while.
